notes: Cleanse Toxins answers Poison effects such as Envenom; Blessing of Freedom removes eligible Paralyzing Shots movement impairment.
Avenger's Shield supplies a ranged primary-target stop, while Hammer of Justice or Blinding Light controls susceptible enemies. Spellwarding is a planned Magic-immunity option, not a dispel.
Cleanse Toxins removes eligible Toxic Spew applications; Blessing of Freedom frees a rooted ally from Bloodthorn Roots.
Use Avenger's Shield only as a primary-target interrupt and coordinate immunity blessings around Forbearance.
Cleanse Toxins removes Toxic Spores; Blessing of Freedom handles eligible roots and snares such as Glacial Tomb.
Avenger's Shield expands the interrupt plan, while Spellwarding can pre-immune a selected ally from eligible magical harm but does not remove an existing debuff.
Cleanse Toxins removes Heartstop Poison but cannot remove Curse of Doom or harmful Magic effects.
Use Avenger's Shield, Rebuke, Hammer of Justice, and Blinding Light as separate planned stops; immunity blessings remain encounter-specific externals.
Cleanse Toxins removes eligible poisons; Blessing of Freedom handles Condensed Mass movement impairment.
Control susceptible enemies and reserve Spellwarding for a deliberate Magic-immunity assignment rather than treating it as a cleanse.
Cleanse Toxins removes Poison Spit and Cytotoxin; Blinding Light or Hammer of Justice helps break A Knot of Snakes and stop susceptible channels.
Avenger's Shield gives the tank a ranged primary-target interrupt; Blessing of Freedom does not substitute for Poison removal.
Cleanse Toxins removes eligible Poison effects; Blessing of Freedom removes Frost Shock movement impairment.
Coordinate ranged and melee interrupts, control susceptible enemies, and use Spellwarding or Protection only for mechanics matching their Magic or Physical immunity domains.
Avenger's Shield adds a ranged primary-target interrupt for Cinderweaver and Tempest Channeler casts.
Blinding Light supplies area control; Spellwarding is a planned magical external and does not remove Blaze of Glory or Stormcloud Barrier from enemies.

recommendations: Use Blinding Light after the orbs cluster; it is Protection Paladin's principal area answer, with Rebuke and Avenger's Shield covering individual casts.
Commit Avenging Wrath when priority damage is needed to kill the Voidbound Emissary on time.
Use Divine Steed to collect partner orbs quickly while preserving safe tank positioning.
Cleanse Toxins can dispel an eligible Poison or Disease application; Blessing of Freedom clears the movement-impairing form and can cover two targets with the relevant talent.

This record combines those source-confirmed tools with WHELP's canonical seasonal mechanic classifications; ratings are original WHELP applicability judgments, not copied rankings.
